summary: Frontend-only UI wiring sweep verified for the global Deep-Dive modal across 11 dashboards. Logged in as admin, dismissed onboarding tour, and validated: (a) new KPI/summary cards open the global deep-dive-modal with correct titles + AI insight; (b) each page's existing page-owned modals still open on their intended rows (regressions preserved); (c) exactly one deep-dive-modal is in the DOM at a time and closes via deep-dive-close.

issues: React console warning: duplicate keys 'Need attention', 'Overdue', 'Resolved' (non-blocking); hydration warning: <span> inside <option> in CompliancePosture crosswalk framework <select> (line ~249) and CyberRisk AIR model <select> (line ~377) — cosmetic HTML validity issue caused by wrapper span with x-excluded attributes.

Regression: discovered-CX-64B2B6D1 row opens the page's rich RiskDetailModal (same deep-dive-modal testid) with asset-specific content (title, risk, ALE, compliance alignment) — distinguishable by content.
verified_flows.Spot-check pages: /app/risks rr-kpi-total, /app/decisions dec-kpi-recs, /app/vendors vnd-kpi-total, /app/ai-governance aig-kpi-queries all open the global deep-dive.

action_items: (Minor) Fix duplicate-key React warnings in list rendering (keys 'Need attention', 'Overdue', 'Resolved').
(Minor) Remove/replace <span> wrappers rendered as children of <select><option> in CompliancePosture (line ~249) and CyberRisk (line ~377) to eliminate hydration warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Deep-dive wiring is uniform and correct: exactly one modal rendered at a time; content is disambiguated by title/content even though both the global RiskDetailModal and some page-owned RiskDetailModals share data-testid='deep-dive-modal'.
Regression stopPropagation working: table rows open their own detail panes; SR exposures open situation-risk-modal; cyber-risk stat KPIs still open cyber-metric-modal.
AI insight loaded within ~15s on all sampled deep-dives (grounded, non-spinning).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Global deep-dive modal is stable across every dashboard tested. If retesting, remember to dismiss the onboarding-tour overlay (click 'Skip') immediately after login. Note that BOTH the global RiskDetailModal and several page-owned modals (Asset Intelligence RiskDetailModal, KernelStatus PolicyModal-adjacent, etc.) share data-testid='deep-dive-modal' — validate by title/content, not just count. Only cosmetic React warnings remain.
